To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) we have a complete combinatorial description of the cluster category of a quiver of Dynkin type A_n, (2) we have a bijection between Ptolemy Diagrams and torsion pairs of the cluster category for Dynkin type D, (3) we have a new combinatorial description and an explicit generating function counting the number of Ptolemy Diagarms for Dynkin type A, B and D.
• We provide a complete classification of the cluster tilting objects in the cluster category C of Dynkin type A_n, by giving a bijection to the set of all partitions.

(1) the number of torsions pairs in the cluster algebra of type D_n can be expressed in terms of Catalan numbers; (2) the cluster category of a Dynkin quiver of type D_n has a bijection to the set of Ptolemy diagram of type D_n; (3) Ptolemy Diagrams of type D_n are in bijection with the set of pairs of partitions of n.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following objects: cluster categories, quiver representation theory, cluster algebras, Ptolemy theory, combinatorics of partitions.
the following questions: What are the Ptolemy diagram of type D?

the following objects: (i) Ptolemy triangles and quadrilaterals (ii) Torsion pairs in the category of representations of the Dynkin quivers of type A and D (iii) The cluster categories of Dynkins type A_n and D_n.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

we have found a bijection between the set of Ptolemy D-diagrams, the set of torsion pairs, the set of exceptional sequences, and the set of tilting complexes in the cluster category C(D_n) of Dynkin type A_n.
the cluster category of a Dynkin diagram of type D is a very well behaved combinatorial object.

the number of torsions pairs of type (T,T^\perp) in the cluster category C of Dynkin type A_n is given by the coefficient of x^n in the generating function (see the paper for the exact expression) where a_n is the n-th Catalan number.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the combinatorial objects Ptolemy diagram and cluster category of type A_n, D_n are dual to each other.
Ptolemy diagram of type D_n can be viewed as a generalization of the classical notion of Ptolemy quadrilateral.
Ptolemy diagram of type D_n are the natural combinatorial objects to study the cluster category of the same type.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the cluster categories of type D_n have a rich structure of torsion pairs that is not visible in the case of Dynkin type A.
the combinatorial structure of Ptolemy Diagrams of Dynkin type A_n and D_n is very different.
the combinatorial objects Ptolemy diagram of type D are in bijection to a certain class of bipartite graphs called Ptolemaic graphs.
